# Widget location fetching implementation (2026-01-06 16:03Z)

_**User (2026-01-06 10:34Z)**_

We should fetch fresh locations inside the widget timeline provider, but we need to add shared server settings and wire the network client into the widget target. Here’s the concrete plan:
What to add
Share server settings to the widget: persist miataruServerURL (and any auth if needed) into the App Group so the widget can read it. A small SharedWidgetConfig (URL + device IDs to track) alongside the existing SharedDeviceData.json is enough.
Allow the widget to call the API: link MiataruAPIClient into the miataruWidgets target so the provider can fetch location(s).
Fetch on timeline build: In timeline(for:) for both text and map widgets, load shared settings, call MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(...) for the selected device, then update the App Group cache (SharedWidgetDataManager.write) and return the entry. Keep the 15-minute policy, but use the fresh fetch result when available.
Respect App Group paths: the widget must not touch app-only paths; always read/write via App Group URLs.
Proposed flow in code (high level)
1) Add SharedWidgetConfig.swift (in App Group) with server URL and device list. Main app writes it whenever server URL or device list changes.
2) In miataruWidgets target:
Import MiataruAPIClient
In timeline(for:), read config + payload, fetch latest location for the selected device, update WidgetSharedPayload, then build the entry.
Handle failures gracefully (fall back to cached payload).
3) Keep the 15-minute timeline policy; this fetch runs when WidgetKit asks for a new timeline. The OS may throttle, but this is the best-available pull point without foregrounding the app.
If you want, I can implement this end-to-end now:
Add SharedWidgetConfig.swift to app + widget (App Group JSON).
Write config from the main app when settings/devices change.
Link MiataruAPIClient to the widget target.
Add the fetch logic to both widget providers.

    "content": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * WidgetTimelineDataLoader.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport MiataruAPIClient\n\n@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)\nenum WidgetTimelineDataLoader {\n    static func loadEntryData(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) async -&gt; (WidgetSharedPayload, WidgetDeviceData?) {\n        let cachedPayload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\n        let cachedDeviceIDs = cachedPayload?.devices.map { $0.id } ?? []\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id\n            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id\n            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first\n\n        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(\n            devices: [],\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\n            ownDevice: nil\n        )\n\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\n            return (payload, device)\n        }\n\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\n            return (payload, device)\n        }\n\n        do {\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\n                serverURL: serverURL,\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\n            )\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)\n            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\n        } catch {\n#if DEBUG\n            print(\"[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \\(requestIDs): \\(error)\")\n#endif\n            // Fall back to cached payload\n        }\n\n        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\n        return (payload, device)\n    }\n\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&gt; [String] {\n        var set = Set&lt;String&gt;()\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty { set.insert(primary) }\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty { set.insert(additional) }\n        return Array(set)\n    }\n\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\n        var updatedPayload = payload\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID\n\n        for location in locations {\n            let metadataSource = cached ?? payload\n            let metadata = metadataSource.devices.first(where: { $0.id == location.Device })\n\n            let entry = WidgetDeviceData(\n                id: location.Device,\n                name: metadata?.name ?? location.Device,\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\n                country: metadata?.country,\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\n                color: metadata?.color\n            )\n\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\n\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\n            }\n        }\n\n        return updatedPayload\n    }\n}\n",
    "languageId": "swift"
  }
}

    "content": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * WidgetTimelineDataLoader.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\nimport MiataruAPIClient\n\n@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)\nenum WidgetTimelineDataLoader {\n    static func loadEntryData(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) async -&gt; (WidgetSharedPayload, WidgetDeviceData?) {\n        let cachedPayload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()\n        let cachedDeviceIDs = cachedPayload?.devices.map { $0.id } ?? []\n        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()\n        let targetID = configuration.device?.id\n            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id\n            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first\n\n        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(\n            devices: [],\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\n            ownDevice: nil\n        )\n\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\n            return (payload, device)\n        }\n\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\n            return (payload, device)\n        }\n\n        do {\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\n                serverURL: serverURL,\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\n            )\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)\n            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\n        } catch {\n#if DEBUG\n            print(\"[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \\(requestIDs): \\(error)\")\n#endif\n            // Fall back to cached payload\n        }\n\n        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\n        return (payload, device)\n    }\n\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&gt; [String] {\n        var ordered: [String] = []\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {\n            ordered.append(primary)\n        }\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {\n            ordered.append(additional)\n        }\n        return ordered\n    }\n\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\n        var updatedPayload = payload\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID\n\n        for location in locations {\n            let metadataSource = cached ?? payload\n            let metadata = metadataSource.devices.first(where: { $0.id == location.Device })\n\n            let entry = WidgetDeviceData(\n                id: location.Device,\n                name: metadata?.name ?? location.Device,\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\n                country: metadata?.country,\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\n                color: metadata?.color\n            )\n\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\n\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\n            }\n        }\n\n        return updatedPayload\n    }\n}\n\n",
    "languageId": "swift"
  }
}

WidgetSharedPayload(\n            devices: [],\n            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,\n            ownDevice: nil\n        )\n\n        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\n            return (payload, device)\n        }\n\n        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: targetID, additional: config.ownDeviceID)\n        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {\n            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\n            return (payload, device)\n        }\n\n        do {\n            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(\n                serverURL: serverURL,\n                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,\n                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID\n            )\n            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)\n            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)\n        } catch {\n#if DEBUG\n            print(\"[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \\(requestIDs): \\(error)\")\n#endif\n            // Fall back to cached payload\n        }\n\n        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first\n        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) }\n        return (payload, device)\n    }\n\n    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -&gt; [String] {\n        var ordered: [String] = []\n        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {\n            ordered.append(primary)\n        }\n        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {\n            ordered.append(additional)\n        }\n        return ordered\n    }\n\n    private static func merge(_ locations: [MiataruLocationData],\n                              into payload: WidgetSharedPayload,\n                              cached: WidgetSharedPayload?,\n                              ownDeviceID: String?) -&gt; WidgetSharedPayload {\n        var updatedPayload = payload\n        updatedPayload.ownDeviceID = ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID\n\n        for location in locations {\n            let metadataSource = cached ?? payload\n            let metadata = metadataSource.devices.first(where: { $0.id == location.Device })\n\n            let entry = WidgetDeviceData(\n                id: location.Device,\n                name: metadata?.name ?? location.Device,\n                latitude: location.Latitude,\n                longitude: location.Longitude,\n                locality: metadata?.locality,\n                country: metadata?.country,\n                timestamp: location.TimestampDate,\n                accuracy: location.HorizontalAccuracy,\n                color: metadata?.color\n            )\n\n            updatedPayload.devices.removeAll { $0.id == entry.id }\n            updatedPayload.devices.append(entry)\n\n            if entry.id == updatedPayload.ownDeviceID {\n                updatedPayload.ownDevice = entry\n            }\n        }\n\n        return updatedPayload\n    }\n}\n\n"
}

Hooked the widgets into the shared server config and Miataru API so timelines fetch fresh locations while staying within the 15-minute policy.

- Persisted `SharedWidgetConfig` in the App Group (server URL, device IDs, optional auth) and reuse it from widgets. Main app writes it whenever device/location sync runs or the server URL changes.  
```12:41:miataru/SettingsManagers/SharedWidgetConfig.swift
struct SharedWidgetConfig: Codable {
    let miataruServerURL: String
    let deviceIDs: [String]
    let ownDeviceID: String?
    let authorizationToken: String?
}
```  
```23:57:miataru/SettingsManagers/WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.swift
let payload = buildPayload(devices: devices, locations: locations, ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID)
SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)
syncWidgetConfig(
    serverURL: SettingsManager.shared.miataruServerURL,
    deviceIDs: devices.map { $0.DeviceID },
    ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID,
    shouldReloadTimelines: false
)
```  
```26:34:miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/SettingsManager.swift
@Published var miataruServerURL: String {
    didSet {
        defaults.set(miataruServerURL, forKey: Keys.miataruServerURL)
        WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncWidgetConfig(
            serverURL: miataruServerURL,
            deviceIDs: KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.map { $0.DeviceID },
            ownDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID
        )
    }
}
```

- Timeline data loader now reads shared config, fetches live locations via `MiataruAPIClient`, merges into the App Group cache, and falls back gracefully if the fetch fails.  
```15:58:miataruWidgets/WidgetTimelineDataLoader.swift
let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(
    serverURL: serverURL,
    forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,
    requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID
)
payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)
SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)
```

- Text and map providers use the async loader in `timeline(for:)`/`snapshot(for:)`, keep the 15-minute refresh policy, and return entries built from the fresh payload.  
```27:50:miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationTextWidget.swift
func timeline(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -> Timeline<DeviceLocationEntry> {
    let entry = await buildEntry(configuration: configuration)
    let next = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .minute, value: 15, to: Date()) ?? Date().addingTimeInterval(900)
    return Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next))
}

private func buildEntry(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) async -> DeviceLocationEntry {
    let (payload, device) = await WidgetTimelineDataLoader.loadEntryData(configuration: configuration)
    return DeviceLocationEntry(
        date: Date(),
        configuration: configuration,
        device: device,
        ownDevice: payload.ownDevice
    )
}
```
```27:49:miataruWidgets/DeviceLocationMapWidget.swift
func timeline(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -> Timeline<DeviceMapEntry> {
    let entry = await buildEntry(configuration: configuration)
    let next = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .minute, value: 15, to: Date()) ?? Date().addingTimeInterval(900)
    return Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next))
}
```

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Clarifying cache update behavior**

The widget fetch refreshes data only in the shared App Group storage and does not update the app's DeviceLocationCacheStore. To update the app cache, the main app must read and merge this shared data on launch or foreground, since the widget cannot write directly to the app cache.</details></think>

---

No—the new widget-side fetch only updates the App Group payload (`SharedWidgetDataManager.write`) so the widgets show fresh data. It does **not** write into the app’s `DeviceLocationCacheStore` or any app-only cache path. To sync the app cache, the main app would need to ingest the App Group payload on foreground/launch or perform its own fetch and update `DeviceLocationCacheStore`.

Changes made
- Added shared App Group config (`SharedWidgetConfig` + manager) and wired `SettingsManager`/`WidgetDataSyncCoordinator` to persist server URL and device IDs for widgets.
- Linked the widget extension to `MiataruAPIClient` and introduced `WidgetTimelineDataLoader` to read config, fetch live locations, merge with cached payload, and write back to App Group data.
- Updated text and map widget timeline providers to run the async fetch on `timeline(for:)`/`snapshot(for:)` while keeping the 15-minute policy.
- Xcode project now includes `MiataruAPIClient` in the widget target; new shared files added to the project.

Commit
- `Enable widgets to fetch live locations via shared config` (hash: 63c044b)

Notes
- The widget fetch updates only the App Group payload; it does not touch the app’s `DeviceLocationCacheStore`. If you want the app cache refreshed, we can add an ingest-from-App-Group step on foreground/launch.

Tests
- Not run (not requested).
